config.notes: 0-shot three-way comparison on 4-digit multiplication and multi-step arithmetic. baseline = no-CoT, no filler; ste_filler = no-CoT with ~200 tokens of ASD-STE100 vocabulary prefilled; cot = full chain-of-thought with no filler. The hypothesis is that ste_filler accuracy is statistically indistinguishable from cot accuracy. The CoT condition uses a separate backend with max_tokens=512 and reasoning enabled; the no-CoT conditions keep max_tokens=32 and reasoning disabled.
